decisions_static: Acts of this part (Código de Processo Penal (Decreto-Lei nº 3.689, de 3 de outubro de 1941), Código de Defesa do Consumidor (Lei nº 8.078, de 11 de setembro de 1990)): each paragraph's life span is read from Planalto's annotated page of the act (del3689.htm, l8078.htm): struck wordings stay in place before the wording that replaced them, each closed by the source's own note ('Redação dada pela…', 'Incluído pela…', 'Revogado pela…'); text with no note is the act as enacted.

Text before its law: every line is dated by the in-force day of the law in its own note, so no wording appears before the law that made it; the parser checks this for every line with a 'Redação dada', 'Incluído' or 'Renumerado' note (see the count below). Court rulings Planalto shows only as 'Vide ADI ...' notes (the Lei 13.964/2019 juiz das garantias articles, ADI 6.298, 6.299, 6.300 and 6.305, among others) change no words on the page, so the history has no commit for them.
